verdict.rationale: Enriching verifications with phone, email, and device risk signals is a fair axis for an identity verification platform, so it applies. The evidence pack documents only Document, Facial Similarity, Known Faces, Watchlist and NFC checks. It contains no documented phone carrier, email risk, address history or device fingerprint check types.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enrich verifications with phone, email, and device risk signals — carrier checks, address history, device fingerprint — as additional documented check types
